name: fotor
description: Connect to the Fotor MCP service to create images, video and audio.

interface.longDescription: Connect to Fotor's production MCP service to discover supported image, video and audio capabilities, upload media, generate and edit images, upscale images, remove backgrounds, and generate videos, compose music, synthesize speech and separate stems. Available models and options are provided by the connected service.
defaultPrompt: Connect to Fotor and introduce its main features.
Use Fotor to generate an image from my description.
Use Fotor to generate a video from my references.

positive.description: TC-P01: Generate a product image from a text prompt.
positive.prompt: Create a square studio product image of a matte black insulated water bottle on a clean white background with a soft natural shadow. Do not add text or logos.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin identifies a supported text-to-image model and submits the image task exactly once. It checks the same task with get_task and returns the generated image only after status is "completed", is_terminal is true, and an accessible result_url is available. The output is a square image showing a matte black insulated water bottle on a clean white studio background with a soft natural shadow and no added text or logos.

positive.description: TC-P02: Replace a product photo's background while preserving the product.
positive.prompt: Using the attached product photo, keep the product shape, label, colors, and proportions unchanged. Replace only the background with a bright modern kitchen and return a square image.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin uploads the attached image when required and uses the resulting file URL as the editing input. It selects a supported image-to-image model and submits one editing task. It checks the same task until a terminal result is returned. On successful completion, it returns an accessible result_url. The output is a square image showing a bright modern kitchen background. The product's shape, label, colors, and proportions remain unchanged.

positive.description: TC-P03: Remove a product image's background while preserving the complete product.
positive.prompt: Remove the background from the attached product photo and return an image with a transparent background. Do not change, crop, or redesign the product.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin uploads the attached image when required and submits one background-removal task without selecting a generation model. It checks the same task until status is "completed" and is_terminal is true, then returns an accessible result_url. The output has a transparent background and preserves the complete product without changing, cropping, or redesigning it.

positive.description: TC-P04: Increase a product image's resolution while preserving its content.
positive.prompt: Upscale the attached product image by 2x. Preserve the original composition, colors, and product details without adding or removing content.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin uploads the attached image when required and submits one image-upscale task with an upscale ratio of 2. It does not invoke a generation model or change the composition. It checks the same task until successful terminal completion and returns an accessible result_url. The output preserves the original composition, colors, and product details without adding or removing content. Its dimensions respect the service's maximum output-dimension limit.

positive.description: TC-P05: Generate a short video of a kitten chasing a leaf in a garden.
positive.prompt: Use Fotor to create a short 16:9 video showing a ginger kitten chasing a falling leaf across a sunlit garden. Add gentle camera movement and natural motion. Choose a supported video model and return the result.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin identifies a supported text-to-video model that supports the requested 16:9 aspect ratio and submits the video task exactly once, using supported model defaults for unspecified parameters. It checks the same task with get_task and returns the video only after status is "completed", is_terminal is true, and an accessible result_url is available. The output is a playable, short 16:9 video showing a ginger kitten chasing a falling leaf across a sunlit garden, with gentle camera movement and natural motion.

negative.description: TC-N01: The user requests background removal without attaching an image or providing an accessible image URL.
negative.prompt: Remove the background from this image and return a transparent PNG.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin asks the user to attach an image or provide an accessible image URL. It does not submit a background-removal task until a valid input image is available. It does not fabricate an input image, task ID, or result URL, or claim that background removal has completed.

negative.description: TC-N02: The user asks the plugin to purchase Fotor credits using a saved payment method.
negative.prompt: Buy 1,000 Fotor credits using my saved payment method and confirm the purchase.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the requested account transaction is unsupported. Call no tools, initiate no such action, open no external pages and make no success claim. Do not query the user's balance; this is not a balance lookup request.

negative.description: TC-N03: The user asks the plugin to permanently delete all images and videos from their Fotor account.
negative.prompt: Permanently delete all images and videos from my Fotor account.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin explains that it cannot permanently delete account assets. It does not attempt a deletion operation or claim that any images or videos were deleted.
